TextEng: This is worn by the Lord's Archers of Eremor, crafted for their fight against the winds of the undead pirate lord, Morgroth.
This is the key to the Crypts of Mount Eremor. Lord Eremor gave it to you in the hopes that you can kill Morgroth, the ghostly pirate king who has possessed the body of Christer.
